I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I confirmed I've noted the correct date: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June. I didn't change anything, since she said no action was needed.

I also suggested she post the correction in #north-team, where the wrong date went up this morning. That way the people who saw it there will see the fix too. I didn't post anything in #north-team myself.
